title: Maze Maker Runner
heading: Maze Maker
help: Pick a step, click Green flag and watch the mole. Click Green flag again for a new try.

1.name: Dig tunnels
1.note: The pen draws a tunnel wherever the mole moves. The tunnels run into each other.

2.name: Look before you dig
2.note: touching color: the mole steps back from tunnels that are already dug, until it gets stuck.

3.name: Go back and try again
3.note: try calls itself. When the mole is stuck, the call ends and the one before carries on. Takes about 15 seconds.

4.name: Instant maze
4.note: The same blocks as step 3, with Run without screen refresh ticked on define try (the blocks look the same).
